name: HMX-17a Ilfa
source:
The newest experimental maid robot from Kurusugawa Electronics, driven by software called 'Dynamic Intelligence Architecture' designed by Sango. [spoiler]The body is customized from the mass-produced HMX-16 'Leon'. Ilfa proposes to work at Sango and Ruri's house during her testing phase which angers Ruri because she takes all her jobs. Even though she is hated by Ruri, Ilfa loves her because Ruri is the one who shows her that the outside world is not frightening. [/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_To_Heart_series_characters#To_Heart_2]Wikipedia[/url].]
